avis.texte: This cleanser feels nice, breaks down makeup and suncreen easily, and doesnt leave any oily film after use. However, the smell is so incredibly terrible. I cannot explain it. The best description I can come up with is something like burning plastic that was covered in mold. It is horrific and for that reason alone, I cannot continue to use it.

I purchased this a few weeks ago and used it for about 2 weeks straight to give it a full review. This removed surface make up but not my mascara, waterproof eyeliner and most of my foundation was still coming off on my second cleanse after using this. Also it was not moisturizing at all. It made my skin feel stripped not at all like other cleansing oils or balms do. I wont be purchasing again.
Great as a makeup remover. I did break out a bit more using it. I don't know if it is ideal for oily skin.
it's nothing crazy special, i use it to remove my makeup and then use a cleanser after.
The cleansing oil itself is fantastic - however, it leaked when shipped, and so I recieved a very oily box in the mail. Not too much seemed to be missing from the bottle though, so that was good.
It's good for my sensitive skin and a good price point compared to other brands. I'm enjoying it

....it really makes my eyes sting, and I am not sensitive to much. Not sure which ingredient is the culprit. Anyhow, the oil itself is really nice and melts my makeup off and it helps moisturize my skin but unfortunately, the stinging is too much for me and won't be buying another bottle.

....it stings my eyes. It totally melts onto my skin (I use on my face and neck) and it's amazing but it comes with a small price of stinging my eyes. Thankfully I don't sensitive eyes or skin so I'm not sure which ingredient is bothering me. Anyhow, it's small price to pay for this benefit. Maybe they can make a sensitive eyes version (?)
Melts away makeup and leaves skin so soft. It even moisturizes your lips!
Not for me. I'm not allergic to anything on my face. Ever. This stuff yes. Horrible rash.

I know that it's a cleansing oil but I guess I didn't realize how oily it'd be. That is the only downside. It's really fast and easy to use and works great. Typically I have to fight my makeup to come off and this did it with much ease.

This worked at removing makeup better than I expected. Has very watery texture but sort of lathers up. I'm sure some people prefer no fragrance but I enjoy the aromatherapy of pixi products so it doesn't feel luxurious but it does a great job of removing makeup without stripping moisture. Would love it more if it had the vitamin c line scent.
I was about to buy this, but then I watched the video. No evidence that any of her makeup came off at all!
